entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this absolute piece of junk VeloBand Pulse you sold me. It's a complete scam.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having a bad experience with your VeloBand. To best help you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Don't give me a script! It's broken! The thing is completely not working. It won't sync with my phone, the readings are a joke, it's a defective paperweight. I want my money back, now. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, sir, and I can certainly look into the return options for you. I don't need to transfer you. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
You better. I'm not wasting my whole day on this. If this isn't settled in five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find. This company is a joke.

Okay, I have your account here. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 35 days ago. Let me just check the policy... yes, it looks like you're all set. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery.
About time you figured that out. So, are you sending the return label or what?
Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
Fine. I'll pack up this broken garbage and send it back. You'd better process my refund the second you get it.
We will. As soon as our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Just don't mess this up.
It's all taken care of. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
